description.zh: 说明：多个座席编号之间以英文逗号( , )分隔，一次最多支持1000个cno；同一座席只能存在于一个外呼组，重复分配会自动移动到新的外呼组中
description.en: The agent IDs. Separate multiple IDs with a comma (,). You can specify up to 1,000 agent IDs in a single request. An agent can belong to only one outbound group. If you assign an agent who is already in another group, the system automatically moves the agent to the new group.

description.zh: 外呼组编号；说明：添加此gno对应的外呼组与cnos对应的座席的绑定从属关系; 同一外呼组最多可包含1000个座席
description.en: The ID of the outbound group. Agents specified by the `Cnos` parameter are assigned to this group. An outbound group can contain a maximum of 1,000 agents.
